source_title: MnDOT Oversize/Overweight Permits (Minn. Stat. 169.80-.87; MN Trucking Regs Section 05, 2022)
verify_reasons: MnDOT publishes no height-based escort or height-pole threshold on its escort requirements page; the height escort array is empty by design. The only overheight structural trigger is a mandatory physical route survey when over 16' high or over 20' wide.
Semitrailer legal length (53') is cross-referenced from Minn. Stat. 169.81, not restated on the MnDOT permit pages; MnDOT publishes overall-combination limits (75') instead.

superload_thresholds.note: MnDOT Superload Corridor network is defined for vehicles up to 16'0" tall x 16'0" wide x 150'0" long x 250,000 lbs (Superload Corridors map, updated Dec 2021); loads above these are superload class. Separately, a mandatory physical route survey is required when over 16'0" high or over 20'0" wide (MN Trucking Regs Section 05).

width.note: trigger width = 15'0" at bottom OR 16'0" at top: 2 escorts (front+rear) on undivided 2-lane; 1 rear escort on multilane divided (escorts.html, Minn. Stat. 169.812). Load extending left of centerline also requires a certified peace officer plus front & rear escorts.

length.note: >=110' overall: 1 rear escort on multilane divided; 2 escorts (front+rear) on undivided 2-lane
>=150' overall: front + rear escorts on divided highways

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize single-trip = $15.00 flat. Oversize/overweight single-trip = $15.00 + a per-mile damage-assessment fee summed across axle groups (rate looked up by each axle-group weight and axle spacing; e.g. 2-axle <=8' spacing $0.00-$0.30/mile). Single-trip overweight is NOT issued above 72,000 lbs per axle group.
single_trip.note: Job/multi-trip oversize = $36 valid 60 days; OS/OW job = $36 + damage-assessment fee x number of moves.

annual.note: Annual overweight by GVW bracket: $200 (<=90,000 lbs) up to $900 (145,001-155,000 lbs). Annual oversize: forest products $300, tow truck $300, livestock $200, commercial boat/double-deck bus $120, baled farm $60; seasonal (harvest/snowplow/winter) $60.

movement_restrictions: No statewide daylight-only rule — travel is not restricted unless noted on the permit
Holidays: no travel from 2:00 p.m. the day before to 2:00 a.m. the day after when over 12'6" wide or over 110' long
Summer weekends (Memorial Day-Labor Day): no travel Fri & Sun 4:00-8:00 p.m. when over 12'6" wide or over 110' long
Rush hour (Twin Cities and Duluth metro): no travel weekdays 6:00-8:30 a.m. and 3:30-6:00 p.m. when over 14'6" wide or over 110' long
Night-travel required (Twin Cities 7-county metro): travel only 12:00 a.m.-5:00 a.m. Mon-Fri when over 16'0" wide
No movement when visibility is under 500 ft or the vehicle cannot hold its lane
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6" (VERIFIED, not 14'0"), gross 80,000 lbs; overall-combination limit 75' (45' single vehicle, 48' mobile crane).

Overweight is axle-group based: the damage-assessment fee is the sum of per-mile rates looked up by each axle-group's weight and spacing, times miles. Single-trip OW not issued above 72,000 lbs per axle group; annual OW priced by GVW bracket.

Escort matrix (escorts.html), superload corridor definition (superloadcorridors.pdf, Dec 2021), and fees (permit-types.html + damage-assessment-fees.html) sourced from official MnDOT pages; MnDOT's 'Guide to transporting superloads' edocs host was unreachable this run.
State-level rules only — county/city permits, bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope.
